correctness.rationale: For every threshold, exact pairwise Bernoulli moments force r<=min(p²,1-3p+3p²), and all eight Bernoulli masses are nonnegative for the specified r; conditional independent uniforms extend them to valid pairwise-independent continuous triples. Odd-parity independent bits of the Sierpiński coupling give S(t)=1-3t+3t² below half and S(t)=S(2t-1)/4 above half, proving the all-threshold formula and its dyadic factorization. A one-variable derivative proves the global relative minimum 3/4. Logistic-marginal L1 error <2/512, via telescoping products, gives the strictly >1/128 counterexample. The checker at the actual packaged path passed 1504 exact rational assertions; its finite range is not treated as a proof of the continuum theorem.

originality.rationale: Full texts of arXiv:2611.14008 and arXiv:1803.10447 and the subsequently released arXiv:2611.20365 were compared by mathematical implication. The generic discrete copula-feasibility criterion, the known Sierpiński maximizer for xyz, and sufficient optimality for special dyadic scores do not state or force the sharp comparison with the pairwise-independent diagonal survival capacity and the explicit analytic-score failure without additional computations and constructions. Searches across source titles, aliases and published-finding corpus were negative for this precise phase theorem; this is not asserted as exhaustive proof of priority.
residual_risks: A specialized copula/orthogonal-array paper could previously have tabulated the same exact odd-parity dyadic survival diagonal and compared it with the general pairwise-independent cap without being returned by search.
Full text of the 2016 diagonal-plane-sections paper was not accessible; its abstract alone is not used as proof of noncoverage.

The 2018 Sierpiński construction gives strong ingredients for deriving the new comparison. Novelty is limited to the completed threshold-capacity/efficiency classification and explicit analytic-cost distinction, not discovery of the coupling or Bernoulli pairwise-independence bounds.
No independent referee or exhaustive priority certification has been performed.

value.rationale: The diagonal joint upper exceedance is a canonical dependence-risk functional. The result completely identifies the thresholds where an established XYZ-product-optimal fractal coupling also optimizes this different dependence criterion, including infinitely many unexpected dyadic equality points, a sharp repeated 25 percent relative loss, and a real-analytic strictly increasing product-score failure with explicit >1/128 gap. This is a motivated complete structural boundary, not an arbitrary isolated numeric example. It does not claim a full arbitrary-score optimization theory.
